description.en: Monitor market-moving news, social sentiment, filings, and price reaction with QVeris so agents can separate confirmed catalysts from noisy attention.
description.zh: 用 QVeris 监控影响市场的新闻、社媒情绪、公告和价格反应，帮助 Agent 区分已确认催化与噪音。

overview.en: Use this skill for daily watchlists, catalyst scans, and event-driven risk checks. It discovers news, social, filing, and quote capabilities, inspects source quality, calls bounded windows, and returns a signal table with confidence and next checks.
overview.zh: 用于每日观察列表、催化扫描和事件驱动风险检查。它发现新闻、社媒、公告和行情能力，检查来源质量，调用限定时间窗口，并返回带信心度和下一步检查的信号表。

description.en: Summarize news and sentiment for one ticker.
description.zh: 汇总单只股票新闻和情绪。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to build a 7-day news and sentiment radar for TSLA. Separate confirmed news, filing events, analyst or media narratives, social momentum, price reaction, and unresolved rumors. Include QVeris calls used and estimated credits.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 为 TSLA 建立 7 日新闻情绪雷达。区分已确认新闻、公告事件、分析师或媒体叙事、社媒热度、价格反应和未证实传闻。包含使用的 QVeris 调用和预计 credits。

description.en: Scan a list for what changed today.
description.zh: 扫描列表里今天发生的变化。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to scan AAPL, NVDA, MSFT, AMD, and TSLA for the strongest news and sentiment changes today. Rank by market relevance, not article count.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 扫描 AAPL、NVDA、MSFT、AMD、TSLA 今天最强的新闻和情绪变化。按市场相关性排序，而不是文章数量。

description.en: Check whether a market rumor has enough evidence.
description.zh: 检查市场传闻是否有足够证据。

prompt.en: Use QVeris to check whether the rumor about this company has credible support. Call news, filings, quote reaction, and social signals, then label it confirmed, weak, or unsupported.
prompt.zh: 用 QVeris 检查这家公司相关传闻是否有可信支持。调用新闻、公告、价格反应和社媒信号，然后标记为已确认、弱证据或无支持。

description.en: Turn structured financial data into callable agent capabilities.
description.zh: 把结构化金融数据变成 Agent 可调用能力。

description.en: Add market data coverage for global research and screening workflows.
description.zh: 为全球研究和筛选工作流补充市场数据覆盖。

description.en: A practical workflow for source-backed A-share monitoring.
description.zh: 面向 A 股监控和来源证据研究的实用工作流。

purpose.en: Find company news, filings, social posts, search trend, and market reaction capabilities.
purpose.zh: 寻找公司新闻、公告、社媒帖子、搜索趋势和市场反应能力。

qveris_api.sample_query: company news social sentiment filings quote reaction API

purpose.en: Check source recency, result fields, pagination, market coverage, and billing_rule before calling.
purpose.zh: 调用前检查来源时效、返回字段、分页、市场覆盖和 billing_rule。

purpose.en: Call only the requested lookback window and convert raw items into signal categories.
purpose.zh: 只调用指定回看窗口，并把原始结果转换成信号类别。

summary.en: This workflow usually needs 5-20 paid Calls after free Discover and Inspect preflight. Cost depends on providers, ticker count, and time window.
summary.zh: 该工作流通常在免费 Discover 和 Inspect 预检后需要 5-20 次付费 Call。费用取决于供应商、股票数量和时间窗口。

note.en: Ask for explicit approval before paid Calls. Inspect billing_rule for every selected capability and reduce scope if the estimate is too high.
note.zh: 付费 Call 前必须获得明确确认。检查每个选定能力的 billing_rule；如果预计成本过高，先缩小范围。

description.en: Define tickers, market, lookback window, and whether the task is daily radar or rumor check.
description.zh: 定义股票、市场、回看窗口，以及任务是每日雷达还是传闻核验。

description.en: Use QVeris to find news, social, filings, and quote reaction capabilities.
description.zh: 用 QVeris 寻找新闻、社媒、公告和价格反应能力。

description.en: Call bounded sources, dedupe events, and cluster signals by catalyst type.
description.zh: 调用限定来源，去重事件，并按催化类型聚类信号。

description.en: Rank market relevance, confidence, what changed, and what needs verification.
description.zh: 排序市场相关性、信心度、变化内容和待验证事项。
